candidates.snippet: News organizations that were targeted by President Donald Trump's attempt to ban them from the White House asked a federal judge to extend his order temporarily restoring their access, describing the ban as an "unlawful assault on the most fundamental First Amendment freedoms." h

The Senate passed a major bill to overhaul college athletics with a large bipartisan vote, 77-22. The bill now moves to the House, but that chamber is on recess until after the November midterms, and it remains to be seen whether it will back the Senate bill. https://t.co/J4OwDyR
